title: On the generalized graded cellular bases for cyclotomic quiver Hecke-Clifford superalgebras
summary: In this paper, we construct semisimple deformations for cyclotomic quiver Hecke-Clifford superalgebras of types $A^{(1)}_{s-1}$, $C^{(1)}_{s}$, $A^{(2)}_{2s}$, $D^{(2)}_{s}$. We derive a unified dimension formula for the bi-weight spaces for cyclotomic quiver Hecke-Clifford superalgebras of types $A^{(1)}_{s-1}$, $C^{(1)}_{s}$, $A^{(2)}_{2s}$, $D^{(2)}_{s}$. We introduce the notion of generalized graded cellular superalgebra.
